description: Under Local government legislation the Minister for Housing, Planning and Local Government is responsible for dividing each city, county, and city and county into local electoral areas. Each county, city and city and county is divided into Local Electoral Areas (LEAs) and members of local authorities are elected in these. LEAs and the number of members to be elected in each are specified in a statutory instrument for each local authority area. In general, LEAs are formed by aggregating Electoral Divisions. Coordinate Reference System: Irish Transverse Mercator. Note : The current Local Electoral Areas and Municipal Districts, except for Cork, reflect the changes as defined in LOCAL ELECTORAL AREAS AND MUNICIPAL DISTRICT ORDERS 2018. S.I.NO27/2019 City Of Cork Local Electoral Areas Order describes the Local Electoral Areas set out in the schedule for the City of Cork, as provided for in the Local Government Act 2019 S.I. No. 28/2019 - County Of Cork Local Electoral Areas And Municipal Districts Order 2019 describes the Local Electoral Areas and Municipal Districts set out in the schedule for the County of Cork This dataset is provided by Tailte Éireann

table:columns.description: Name of the unit in Irish.

table:columns.description: Name of the county the unit lies in, in Irish.

table:columns.name: COUNTY
table:columns.description: Name of the county the unit lies in, in English.

table:columns.name: PROVINCE
table:columns.description: Name of the province the unit lies in.

table:columns.name: GUID
table:columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the boundary object in the Tailte Eireann PRIME2 database; the stable key across data versions.

table:columns.name: CENTROID_X
table:columns.description: Easting of the unit centroid in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.

table:columns.name: CENTROID_Y
table:columns.description: Northing of the unit centroid in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.

table:columns.name: AREA
table:columns.description: Area of the unit as computed by the publisher in Irish Transverse Mercator, in square metres.

table:columns.name: ESRI_OID
table:columns.description: Internal row number of the ArcGIS service; not stable across data versions.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Area computed by the ArcGIS service in the units of its spatial reference (Irish Transverse Mercator square metres); not derived from the converted WGS 84 geometry.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Perimeter or line length computed by the ArcGIS service in the units of its spatial reference (Irish Transverse Mercator metres); not derived from the converted WGS 84 geometry.
